def _t_eval(target, _t, scope):
    t_path = _T_PATHS[_t]
    i = 1
    if t_path[0] is T:
        cur = target
    elif t_path[0] is S:
        cur = scope
    else:
        raise ValueError('TType instance with invalid root object')
    # Stack to track visited targets for UP operations
    path_stack = [(None, None, target)]
    while i < len(t_path):
        op, arg = t_path[i], t_path[i + 1]
        if type(arg) in (Spec, TType, Literal):
            arg = scope[glom](target, arg, scope)
        if op == '.':
            try:
                prev_target = path_stack[-1][2]
                new_cur = getattr(prev_target, arg)
                path_stack.append((prev_target, '.', new_cur))
                cur = new_cur
            except AttributeError as e:
                raise PathAccessError(e, Path(_t), i // 2)
        elif op == '[':
            if arg is UP:
                # Go up one level in the path history
                # Pop the last entry and index into its target with [0]
                if len(path_stack) > 1:
                    path_stack.pop()
                    cur = path_stack[-1][2][0]
                # else: already at root, stay where we are
            else:
                try:
                    prev_target = path_stack[-1][2]
                    new_cur = prev_target[arg]
                    path_stack.append((prev_target, '[', new_cur))
                    cur = new_cur
                except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError):
                    # Failed indexing - don't add to stack, continue processing
                    pass
        elif op == 'P':
            # Path type stuff (fuzzy match)
            get = scope[TargetRegistry].get_handler('get', cur, path=t_path[2:i+2:2])
            try:
                prev_target = path_stack[-1][2]
                new_cur = get(cur, arg)
                path_stack.append((prev_target, 'P', new_cur))
                cur = new_cur
            except Exception as e:
                raise PathAccessError(e, Path(_t), i // 2)
        elif op == '(':
            args, kwargs = arg
            scope[Path] += t_path[2:i+2:2]
            cur = scope[glom](
                target, Call(cur, args, kwargs), scope)
            prev_target = path_stack[-1][2]
            path_stack.append((prev_target, '(', cur))
            # call with target rather than cur,
            # because it is probably more intuitive
            # if args to the call "reset" their path
            # e.g. "T.a" should mean the same thing
            # in both of these specs: T.a and T.b(T.a)
        i += 2
    return cur
